title: Graph Simulation Response
description: Graph simulation response returned by the NetVigil XR security simulation engine (Rust/WASM). Contract version 1.0. Contains independent network reachability and service dependency impact results. Uses oneOf to distinguish success from error responses.

oneOf.description: Success response with network reachability and service impact results.

contract_version.description: Echo of the request contract_version. Always "1.0" for contract v1.0.

reachable_asset_ids.description: Sorted ascending array of asset IDs reachable from any attack source.

unreachable_asset_ids.description: Sorted ascending array of asset IDs that were available in the input but are not reachable.

witnesses.description: Deterministic shortest-path witness for every reachable asset, sorted by target_asset.

asset_path.description: Ordered array of asset IDs from source to target (inclusive).

edge_path.description: Ordered array of edge IDs traversed. Length is one less than asset_path length.

initially_unavailable_asset_ids.description: Sorted ascending array of asset IDs supplied as unavailable in the input.

impacted_dependent_asset_ids.description: Sorted ascending array of asset IDs that became impacted through propagation, excluding initial unavailable assets.

unavailable_asset_ids.description: Sorted ascending union of initially unavailable and impacted assets.

oneOf.description: Error response returned when the request is invalid.

code.description: Error code from the documented taxonomy.

examples.message: A referenced asset does not exist.

versioning_rules: The response contract_version always matches the request contract_version.
New response fields for future contract versions are additive only.
Removed fields require a new contract version.
error_behavior: When the request is invalid, the engine returns an error object instead: { code, message }.

Error codes: MALFORMED_JSON, UNSUPPORTED_CONTRACT_VERSION, INVALID_REQUEST_ID, INVALID_SCENARIO_ID, INVALID_GRAPH, DUPLICATE_ASSET_ID, DUPLICATE_NETWORK_EDGE_ID, DUPLICATE_SERVICE_DEPENDENCY_ID, DUPLICATE_SERVICE_RELATIONSHIP, UNKNOWN_ASSET_REFERENCE, DUPLICATE_NETWORK_RELATIONSHIP, SELF_LOOP_NOT_ALLOWED, SOURCE_ASSET_UNAVAILABLE, DUPLICATE_ATTACK_SOURCE_ID, LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
The TypeScript adapter must validate the response shape and distinguish success from error responses.
response_invariants: Exactly one witness per reachable asset.
Witness target_asset equals the corresponding entry in reachable_asset_ids.
All returned identifiers exist in the request.
All output ID arrays are sorted and unique.
unavailable_asset_ids equals the sorted union of initial and propagated unavailable assets.
